title: Deserialization of untrusted data in Microsoft Office SharePoint allows an authorized attacker to… (CVE-2026-124223)
description: A deserialization vulnerability in Microsoft Office SharePoint allows an authorized attacker to execute arbitrary code remotely over a network. This vulnerability requires the attacker to have some level of authorization. The flaw is classified under CWE-502 and carries a high severity rating with a CVSS score of 8.8.
